evidence: The Company's expanding use of AI tools and related technologies introduces additional operational risks, including reliance on data integrity and model performance as well as third-party AI services that may fail, degrade, or produce inaccurate or unexpected outputs.

AI-enabled technologies may further expand the cyber-attack surface and velocity, including exposure to adversarial manipulation, data poisoning, and vulnerabilities in third-party AI and other platforms.
advances in AI, such as the use of machine learning, generative AI, and quantum computing by malicious actors to develop more advanced social engineering attacks on the Company or its clients
Ineffective implementation of AI by us or our third-party providers could subject us to additional risks that we cannot adequately predict or mitigate.
Regulatory and other legal frameworks surrounding AI continue to evolve and remain uncertain.
ai_positioning.summary: TFC adopte une posture défensive face à l'IA, mettant l'accent sur les risques opérationnels, cybersécuritaires et réglementaires liés à l'utilisation croissante d'outils IA en interne et via des prestataires tiers, sans démontrer de stratégie offensive ou de développement propriétaire.
